tagline: The picture bingo everyone grew up with, called in five languages. A whole room plays from one QR code, and no phone is required.
joinInvalid: The code has 5 letters or numbers (no I, L, O, 0 or 1).
joinHelp: Type the 5-character code shown on the cantor's screen.
languagesIntro: Cards are called in these languages. Names in Indigenous languages are only called once native speakers have reviewed them.

one.title: The room opens
one.body: Every player gets 1 board of 4 columns × 4 rows.

two.title: A card is called
two.body: Each card comes up once, named in the chosen language, and everyone must pick the correct written form. The first to answer correctly earns 2× points (they break ties). Everyone who answers correctly gets one point; anyone who misses gets none, but everyone who has the picture on their board gets to mark it, and the correct written form appears.

three.title: A board is completed
three.body: Whoever completes their board says ¡Lotería! If several people complete theirs, the one with the most points takes the round.

inclusion.paper: Play with paper only: the cantor uses one screen and no phone is needed.
inclusion.access: Adjustable text size, high contrast, Listen mode and full keyboard support.
inclusion.private: No accounts. Your name and marks stay on your device.
inclusion.offline: Works offline after the first visit.

audience.classroom: Classrooms and community centres: one screen calls, and everyone plays on paper or on a phone.
audience.family: Multilingual families: grandparents call in their own language while the young ones find the pictures.
audience.heritage: People learning a heritage language: Listen mode calls just the word, to learn by ear.

devNotice: This is an early version. Illustrations are placeholder emoji, and the Nahuatl, Maya and Quechua names are waiting for native-speaker review. We never present an unreviewed word as correct.
privacyLine: No accounts or tracking cookies. What you type never leaves your device.
nameHint: Only people in your room see it. It is not saved on any server.
nameRequired: Type your name to create a room.
createHint: You organise, the automatic voice calls
scanHelp: Open your phone's camera and point it at the room's QR: it brings you straight here.
footerLine: No accounts, no money. Just little beans.
